settings.two_factor.status.on.description: Value of the two-factor authentication term while it is on.

settings.two_factor.status.off.defaultMessage: Off. Signing in asks only for your password.
settings.two_factor.status.off.description: Text of the two-factor authentication page while it is off.

settings.two_factor.enrolled_at.description: Term of the description list: when two-factor authentication was turned on; the value is a date and time.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.remai.description: Term of the description list: how many recovery codes are left; the value is a number.

settings.two_factor.setup.title.description: Heading of the region that enrolls an authenticator app while two-factor authentication is off.

settings.two_factor.setup.description.defaultMessage: Add this account to an authenticator app on your phone. From then on, signing in also asks for the six-digit code that the app shows.
settings.two_factor.setup.description.description: Explanation above the button that starts setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.start.description: Button that generates a new secret to add to an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.step.scan.defaultMessage: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it.
settings.two_factor.setup.step.scan.description: First step of setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.step.confirm.defaultMessage: Enter the six-digit code that the app shows to turn on two-factor authentication.
settings.two_factor.setup.step.confirm.description: Second step of setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.qr_code.defaultMessage: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.two_factor.setup.qr_code.description: Accessible name of the QR code image that holds the secret for the authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.secret.description: Label of the secret shown as text, for typing it into an authenticator app instead of scanning the QR code.

settings.two_factor.setup.code.descripti.defaultMessage: The six-digit code that the app shows now.
settings.two_factor.setup.code.descripti.description: Help under the code field that confirms the setup of an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.submit.description: Button that turns two-factor authentication on with the code of the app.

settings.two_factor.setup.expired.defaultMessage: The setup took too long. Start again.
settings.two_factor.setup.expired.description: Error when the setup of an authenticator app expired (after 15 minutes) before its code was entered.

settings.two_factor.code.description: Label of the field for a code of the authenticator app or a recovery code.

settings.two_factor.code.description.defaultMessage: A code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
settings.two_factor.code.description.description: Help under the code field that confirms replacing the recovery codes or turning two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.code.required.description: Error of an empty code field.

settings.two_factor.code.invalid.defaultMessage: The code is incorrect or was already used.
settings.two_factor.code.invalid.description: Error of the code field when the server refused the code.

settings.two_factor.state_changed.defaultMessage: Two-factor authentication was changed elsewhere. The page now shows its current setting.
settings.two_factor.state_changed.description: Error when two-factor authentication was turned on or off in another tab or device meanwhile.

settings.two_factor.rate_limited.description: Error after too many wrong codes. {reason} is the server's explanation of when to try again.

settings.two_factor.failed.description: Error when a change of two-factor authentication failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

settings.two_factor.enabled.description: Status message after turning two-factor authentication on.

settings.two_factor.disabled.description: Status message after turning two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.title.description: Heading of the region that replaces the recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.descr.defaultMessage: If you lose your authenticator app, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once. New codes replace the old ones, which stop working.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.descr.description: Explanation of the recovery codes above the form that replaces them.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.description: Button that replaces the recovery codes with new ones.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.defaultMessage: New recovery codes are ready. The old ones no longer work.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.description: Status message after replacing the recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.t.description: Heading of the list of new recovery codes, which is shown only once.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.d.defaultMessage: Keep these codes somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are shown only now. Each one signs you in once without the app.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.d.description: Text above the list of new recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.disable.title.description: Heading of the region that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.disable.description.defaultMessage: Signing in will ask only for your password. Enter a code to confirm.
settings.two_factor.disable.description.description: Explanation above the form that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.disable.submit.description: Button that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.visibility.direct.description: Visibility option: only the mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.direct.description.description: Description of the 'Mentioned people' visibility option.

settings.visibility.local.description: Visibility option: signed-in users of this server and followers.

settings.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: People signed in to this server, and your followers
settings.visibility.local.description.description: Description of the 'This server' visibility option.

settings.visibility.private.description: Visibility option: followers and mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Your followers and the people you mention

settings.visibility.public.description: Visibility option: everyone, listed on public timelines.

settings.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, and shown on public timelines

settings.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility option: everyone, but kept off public timelines.

settings.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, but kept off public timelines

shell.about.domain.description: In the side column about this server: the domain of the handles of local accounts, for example 'Accounts here end with @example.com.'.

shell.about.title.description: Heading of the side column, shown on wide screens, that tells about the server the user is on.

shell.document_title.description: The browser tab title: the heading of the current page, then the server's name.

shell.error.forbidden.heading.defaultMessage: You do not have permission to see this page
shell.error.forbidden.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server refused the user (a 403); the server's reason follows.

shell.error.network.heading.defaultMessage: Could not connect to the server
shell.error.network.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the page got no answer from the server (offline, or the server is down).

shell.error.not_found.heading.defaultMessage: What this page shows was not found
shell.error.not_found.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server found nothing to show (a 404); the server's reason follows.

shell.error.retry.description: Button that loads the failed page again.

shell.error.server.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server failed to answer its request; the server's reason follows.

shell.error.title.description: Heading of the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.error.unexpected.heading.defaultMessage: This page could not be shown
shell.error.unexpected.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the page itself broke (not a failed request).

shell.error.unexpected.reason.defaultMessage: Try again, or come back later.
shell.error.unexpected.reason.description: Text under the heading of a page's error when the page itself broke.

shell.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while a page loads.

shell.menu.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the navigation menu's sheet.

shell.menu.title.description: Heading and accessible name of the sheet that the tab bar's menu button opens on phones, with the navigation items that are not in the tab bar.

shell.nav.admin.description: Navigation item to the admin screens, shown only to users whose roles have an admin permission.

shell.nav.admin_pending.defaultMessage: Administration, {count, plural, one {# pending} other {# pending}}
shell.nav.admin_pending.description: Accessible name of the navigation item to the admin screens while open reports or registrations awaiting approval wait for the moderators; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation item that opens the home timeline. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation (the tab bar on phones, the side rail on larger screens).

shell.nav.local.description: Navigation item that opens the local timeline (posts of this server's accounts). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets. On phones the same timeline is a tab of the Timelines screen instead.

shell.nav.menu.description: Button of the bottom tab bar on phones that opens a sheet with the rest of the navigation (profile, settings). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bar of five items on a 320 px screen.

shell.nav.menu_pending.defaultMessage: Menu, {count, plural, one {# pending in administration} other {# pending in administration}}
shell.nav.menu_pending.description: Accessible name of the phone tab bar's Menu button while things await the moderators in the administration, which the menu leads to; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications_unread.defaultMessage: Notifications, {count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}}
shell.nav.notifications_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item that opens the notifications while some are unread. Start it with the text of shell.nav.notifications, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread notifications.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.public.description: Navigation item that opens the federated timeline (public posts of this server and of other servers). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets. On phones the same timeline is a tab of the Timelines screen instead.

shell.nav.search.description: Navigation item that opens the account search. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.timelines.description: Item of the bottom tab bar on phones that opens the screen with the local and federated timelines as tabs. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bar of five items on a 320 px screen.

shell.nav.viewer.defaultMessage: The account you are signed in with
shell.nav.viewer.description: Description read after the name of the link at the bottom of the desktop sidebar that shows the signed-in account (avatar, display name, handle) and opens its profile.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: There is no page at this address.
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.description: Link on the not-found page back to the home timeline.

shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.offline.defaultMessage: You are offline. Anything that failed to load loads again when you are back online.
shell.offline.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached. Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Too many requests were sent to the server. What failed to load loads again at {time}.
shell.rate_limited.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the server's rate limit refuses requests (HTTP 429). {time} is the time of day the app loads again, with seconds (for example 12:34:56). Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: The server sent settings the app cannot read. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.

shell.update.apply.description: Button in the message about a new version of the app; pressing it reloads the page into the new version.

shell.update.available.defaultMessage: A new version of the app is available.
shell.update.available.description: Message shown when a new version of the web app has been downloaded and waits until the user applies it.

status.action.bookmark.description: Toggle button under a post that bookmarks it or removes the bookmark. Bookmarks are private. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.boost.description: Toggle button under a post that shares (boosts) it with the user's followers, or retracts the boost. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.copy_link.description: Menu item that copies the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.action.delete.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that asks to delete it.

status.action.failed.description: Toast when boosting, favouriting or bookmarking a post failed; the button is set back. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.action.favourite.description: Toggle button under a post that adds it to or removes it from the user's favourites. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.more.description: Button under a post that opens a menu with more actions on it, and the name of that menu.

status.action.reply.description: Button under a post that starts a reply to it.

status.bookmark.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed the bookmark of a post.

status.bookmark.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user bookmarked a post.

status.boost.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user retracted the boost of a post.

status.boost.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user boosted a post.

status.delete.cancel.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that keeps the post.

status.delete.confirm.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that deletes the post.

status.delete.description.defaultMessage: It will be removed for everyone, along with its boosts and favourites. You cannot undo this.
status.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.delete.done.description: Toast after the user's post was deleted.

status.delete.failed.description: Toast when deleting the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.delete.title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.favourite.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed a post from their favourites.

status.favourite.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user favourited a post.

status.focused.boosts.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many times it was boosted. Shown only when it was.

status.focused.favourites.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many people favourited it. Shown only when someone did.

status.focused.label.description: Not shown: read out by screen readers before the author and time of the post a page is about, to tell it apart from the posts of its thread.

status.link.copied.description: Toast after the address of a post was copied to the clipboard.

status.link.failed.description: Toast when the browser refused to copy the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.not_found.body.defaultMessage: This post does not exist, or you cannot see it.
status.not_found.body.description: Text under the heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.original.description: Accessible name of the link on a post of another server to its page on that server; the link shows only {host}, that server's host name, for example 'mastodon.social'.

status.thread.ancestors.description: Heading above the posts that the post of the page replies to, oldest first.

status.thread.failed.description: Shown under the post of the page when its thread failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy replies section while the thread around a post loads.

status.thread.no_replies.description: Shown under the Replies heading when the post has no replies.

status.thread.replies.description: Heading above the replies to the post of the page.

status.thread.retry.description: Button that loads the thread around a post again after a failure.

status.title.description: Heading of the page of one post and the thread around it.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.account.heading.description: Shown instead of the posts of a profile's tab when it has none.

timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: Your posts and the posts of the people you follow appear here.
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of the people on this server appear here.
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.public.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of people here and on the servers this one knows will appear here.
timeline.empty.public.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty federated timeline.

timeline.empty.public.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the federated timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: In the timeline, Page Down and Page Up move between posts.
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy region while posts load: the first page of a timeline, or a post page.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Badge on a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text); screen readers read it as the picture's name.

timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.new_posts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
timeline.new_posts.description: Button above the home timeline when new posts have arrived; pressing it shows them at the top. Screen readers also read it out when the count changes.

timeline.new_posts.failed.defaultMessage: Could not load the new posts: {reason}
timeline.new_posts.failed.description: Message read out when pressing the new posts button failed to load them. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.action.description: Link on the home page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: Sign in to read the posts of the people you follow.
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Text on the home page when nobody is signed in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.

timeline.tabs.label.description: Accessible name of the tabs that switch between the local and the federated timeline.

timeline.tabs.local.description: Tab that opens the local timeline (public posts of this server's accounts).

timeline.tabs.public.description: Tab that opens the federated timeline (public posts of this server and of the other servers it knows).
